# metaphor-syphon

> Syphon output for [metaphor](https://github.com/shinyaoguri/metaphor) sketches, as a separate SwiftPM package. Publishes the sketch's final frame as a Syphon server (MadMapper / Resolume / VDMX / TouchDesigner read it). metaphor ≥ 0.12.0, macOS 14+, Apple Silicon, Swift 5.10+.

This file is the AI-facing API reference for the package (metaphor's own `llms.txt` covers the core API). The shapes below are the whole public surface; the package is intentionally small.

## Setup

```swift
// Package.swift
dependencies: [
    .package(url: "https://github.com/shinyaoguri/metaphor.git", from: "0.12.0"),
    .package(url: "https://github.com/shinyaoguri/metaphor-syphon.git", from: "0.1.0"),
],
targets: [
    .executableTarget(
        name: "MySketch",
        dependencies: [
            .product(name: "metaphor", package: "metaphor"),              // or "MetaphorCore"
            .product(name: "MetaphorSyphon", package: "metaphor-syphon"),
        ]
    )
]
```

```swift
import metaphor          // or: import MetaphorCore
import MetaphorSyphon    // linking this registers the Syphon output provider at load time

@main
final class MySketch: Sketch {
    var config: SketchConfig {
        SketchConfig(width: 1920, height: 1080, title: "Preview", plugins: [.syphon()])
    }
    func draw() { /* ... */ }
}
```

## API

### PluginFactory.syphon(name:) — declare the output

```swift
extension PluginFactory {
    /// Syphon output. `name == nil` publishes under `SketchConfig.title`
    /// (under the process name when used in `SketchWindowConfig.plugins`, which has no Sketch).
    /// Declares `PluginRequirements.externalRenderLoop`: a `.displayLink` sketch switches to
    /// timer-driven rendering so publishing continues while the window is hidden.
    public static func syphon(name: String? = nil) -> PluginFactory
}
```

Use it in `SketchConfig(plugins:)` for the primary sketch and in `SketchWindowConfig(plugins:)` for secondary windows (`createWindow(...)`); each window becomes its own server.

### METAPHOR_SYPHON_NAME — enable without touching the sketch

Any sketch that links `MetaphorSyphon` publishes under `$METAPHOR_SYPHON_NAME` when the variable is set and non-empty (`metaphor run --syphon[=name]` / `metaphor watch --syphon[=name]` set it for the child process). It is independent of `.syphon(name:)`: declaring both gives two servers.

Precedence for the automatic (provider) server: `METAPHOR_SYPHON_NAME` > deprecated `SketchConfig.syphonName` > (deprecated `SketchConfig.syphon == true` ? `SketchConfig.title` : none). Secondary windows only honour the deprecated `SketchWindowConfig.syphonName`. Headless runs (`METAPHOR_VIEWER=1`) never publish implicitly.

### MetaphorSyphon — module facade

```swift
public enum MetaphorSyphon {
    /// This package's release version (e.g. "0.1.0").
    public static let version: String
    /// Registers the output provider explicitly. Normally unnecessary (a C constructor
    /// registers it at load); idempotent (same provider id → replaced, not duplicated).
    public static func enable()
}
```

### MetaphorRenderer extension — imperative facade

```swift
extension MetaphorRenderer {
    /// The SyphonOutput of the registered Syphon plugin, or nil.
    public var syphonOutput: SyphonOutput? { get }
    /// Starts (or replaces) the Syphon server under `name`.
    public func startSyphonServer(name: String)
    /// Stops the Syphon server and removes the plugin.
    public func stopSyphonServer()
}
```

### SyphonOutput — the server wrapper

```swift
public final class SyphonOutput {
    public init(device: MTLDevice, name: String)
    public var serverName: String? { get }
    public var isActive: Bool { get }
    /// Publishes `texture` to connected clients. `region` nil = whole texture.
    public func publish(texture: MTLTexture, commandBuffer: MTLCommandBuffer, region: NSRect? = nil, flipped: Bool = false)
    /// Stops the current server and starts a new one under `name`.
    public func rename(_ name: String)
    public func stop()
}
```

Published frames carry **premultiplied alpha** (metaphor ADR-0012); receivers must composite with premultiplied `over`.

## Migration from metaphor ≤ 0.11

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| `import metaphor` alone enabled Syphon | add the metaphor-syphon dependency + `import MetaphorSyphon` |
| `SketchConfig(syphon: true)` | `SketchConfig(plugins: [.syphon()])` |
| `SketchConfig(syphonName: "X")` | `SketchConfig(plugins: [.syphon(name: "X")])` |
| `SketchWindowConfig(syphonName: "X")` | `SketchWindowConfig(plugins: [.syphon(name: "X")])` |

The deprecated fields still work while this package is linked (removed in the next metaphor minor). Without the dependency, metaphor prints a one-line diagnostic pointing here and does not publish.

## Behaviour notes

- The server is created when the plugin attaches (sketch start) and destroyed on detach/shutdown; after `noLoop()` the last frame stays visible to clients.
- Frames are published `flipped: true` by the plugin (the orientation Syphon clients expect from metaphor).
- Not related to the metaphor-cli live viewer: `metaphor watch` transfers frames over its own frame IPC (metaphor ADR-0014); Syphon is only for external applications.
